beginner.summary: For developers and DBAs new to MongoDB. Covers document databases, installation and Atlas, databases and collections, inserting, querying and updating documents, query operators, projections and sorting, arrays and embedded documents, data modelling, indexes, the aggregation pipeline, schema validation, transactions, drivers, users and roles, backups, Atlas search, change streams and Compass.
prerequisites: Writes code in JavaScript or Python
Basic database concepts such as tables and keys
outcomes: Store, query and update documents with mongosh and drivers
Model data with embedding and references
Index collections and build aggregation pipelines
Secure, back up and run MongoDB on Atlas

days.topic: MongoDB Overview, Atlas and Local Setup
subtopics: Document databases compared with relational databases
Installing MongoDB locally and with Docker
Creating a free MongoDB Atlas cluster
The course project: an online bookshop
days.lab_task: Run MongoDB in Docker and create a free Atlas cluster, connect to both with mongosh and Compass, load the sample data and explore the collections.
checks: Dates, ObjectId and decimals described correctly

subtopics: Databases and collections created on first use
days.lab_task: Create a books collection, insert documents with nested authors and arrays of tags, import 10,000 books from JSON and handle a duplicate key error in an unordered insert.
Answer ten questions about the bookshop, including books under a price in two genres, books by an author's nested name and books with a given tag.
Return only titles and prices sorted by price, page through results with skip and then with range-based paging, and sort titles correctly with a collation.
checks: Range paging faster for deep pages

days.lab_task: Update stock counts, add and remove tags, update one item inside an order's array, upsert inventory records and delete discontinued books.

days.topic: Working with Arrays and Embedded Documents
subtopics: Arrays of values and arrays of documents
days.lab_task: Query orders whose items match two conditions on the same element, update items with array filters and find a document whose array grows without limit.
checks: Only orders with one matching item returned

days.lab_task: Model the bookshop's customers, orders, reviews and authors for its main queries, choosing embedding or references for each relationship with reasons.
checks: Model supports each in one query where possible
Embed or reference justified by size and access

days.lab_task: Apply the bucket pattern to page views, the computed pattern to book ratings, the subset pattern to recent reviews and add schema versions to customers.
checks: Fewer documents with the same data

subtopics: The ESR rule: equality, sort and range
days.lab_task: Load a million orders, explain three slow queries, add compound indexes following the ESR rule and show the change in documents examined and time.

days.topic: Special Indexes: Text, Geospatial, TTL and Partial
days.lab_task: Add a text index for book search, find stores near a customer with 2dsphere, expire sessions with TTL, index only active products with a partial index and test dropping an index by hiding it.
checks: Stores within 5 km in distance order
Query plan changes and the effect is measured

days.lab_task: Build pipelines for revenue by month and genre, the top ten authors by sales and average order size per country, and move $match to the start for speed.

subtopics: When to model instead of joining
days.lab_task: Join orders with customers, build a faceted search result with counts by genre and price band, calculate running totals with window functions and save a summary with $merge.
checks: Counts by genre and price band

days.lab_task: Add JSON Schema validation to orders, test rejected inserts, apply moderate validation to existing data and plan a schema change.
checks: Update an old document under moderate validation
Steps for old and new documents

days.lab_task: Place an order that updates stock and creates an order in one transaction, fail it half-way to show rollback and compare with a single-document design.

subtopics: Object document mappers: Mongoose and Beanie
tools: Node.js with the MongoDB driver or Python with PyMongo
days.lab_task: Build a small API for books and orders with the driver, validate input to stop query injection, handle errors and test against a test database.
checks: Treated as data, not a query

days.lab_task: Create an application user with read and write on one database, a read-only analyst, restrict Atlas network access and run the security checklist.
checks: Each item passes or is justified

days.lab_task: Back up with mongodump, restore a deleted collection, take an Atlas snapshot and restore the cluster to a point before a bad update.
checks: Restore to a point in time

days.lab_task: Add search with autocomplete and typo tolerance for book titles, add embeddings for descriptions and build a semantic search for similar books.
Watch orders with a change stream to send notifications, resume after a restart without missing events and create an Atlas Trigger that updates stock.
days.deliverable: Listener code, trigger and test results
checks: Missed events processed from the resume token

days.lab_task: Build the bookshop database with a modelled schema, validation, indexes, reporting pipelines, search, transactions for orders, secured users, backups and a small API, then demo it.
days.deliverable: Scripts, pipelines, API code and demo recording
checks: Place an order in the demo
objectives: Combine the beginner topics in one database

intermediate.summary: For developers and DBAs running MongoDB. Covers replica sets, read and write concerns in depth, sharding, shard keys, balancing, performance tuning, the profiler, WiredTiger, connection management, advanced modelling, time series collections, Queryable Encryption, monitoring, Atlas operations, Kubernetes operators, migrations from relational databases, upgrades, data APIs, testing and the developer certification.
prerequisites: Models documents, writes queries and builds aggregation pipelines
Creates indexes and reads explain output
Uses a driver in an application
outcomes: Run replica sets and sharded clusters
Secure, monitor and operate MongoDB on Atlas or Kubernetes
Migrate relational data and pass the developer certification

days.lab_task: Build a three-member replica set, stop the primary and watch an election, read from secondaries, add a delayed member and measure lag.
days.deliverable: Configuration, election log and lag readings

days.topic: Write Concern, Read Concern and Causal Consistency
days.lab_task: Show a stale read from a secondary, fix it with a causally consistent session and compare latency for write concerns 1 and majority.
checks: Read from a secondary after a write

days.lab_task: Build a small sharded cluster, shard the orders collection, insert data and see how it is spread across shards.
Test three shard keys for orders, find the one that causes a hot shard, reshard to a better key online and compare distribution.
days.deliverable: Key tests, resharding log and distribution
checks: Even spread with the new key

days.lab_task: Pin EU customers to an EU shard with zones, set a balancer window and fix a jumbo chunk.

subtopics: Atlas Performance Advisor and Query Insights
days.lab_task: Turn on the profiler, find the five slowest queries, fix them with indexes or query changes and remove unused indexes found with $indexStats.
days.deliverable: Tuning log with before and after data

days.lab_task: Watch cache use under load, change compression for a collection, measure the effect on size and speed and size a server for a growing working set.
Fix an application that opens a new connection per request, tune pool sizes and timeouts and show retries surviving a failover.
Redesign the bookshop model for ten million customers and sharding, model category trees, keep order history versions and review the design with a peer.
days.deliverable: Model, migration plan and review notes
checks: Hot spots and growth risks addressed

subtopics: Time series compared with the bucket pattern
days.lab_task: Store sensor readings in a time series collection, query averages per hour, expire data after 90 days and compare storage with a normal collection.
Encrypt customer phone numbers and national IDs with Queryable Encryption, query by encrypted value, rotate a key and confirm the server never sees plain text.
checks: Read data as a database admin

days.lab_task: Monitor a replica set with Atlas alerts and Grafana, alert on replication lag, oplog window and connections and write runbooks.
checks: Alert fires before it is too small

days.lab_task: Manage an Atlas project with Terraform: a multi-region cluster, private endpoint, auto-scaling and alerts, then scale it and review the bill.
days.deliverable: Terraform code, cluster settings and cost review

days.lab_task: Deploy a replica set with an operator, back it up to object storage, delete a pod and restore a new cluster from backup.

days.topic: Migrating from Relational Databases to MongoDB
days.lab_task: Migrate a relational order schema to MongoDB with Relational Migrator, choose embedding for order lines, rewrite five queries and validate counts and totals.
Upgrade a replica set by one major version with a rolling upgrade, set the feature compatibility version and run application tests.

days.topic: Data APIs, GraphQL and App Services Patterns
days.lab_task: Build REST and GraphQL APIs over the bookshop with cursor pagination, field-level permissions and rate limits.
Add integration tests with a MongoDB container, tests for three aggregation pipelines and a migration test, and run them in CI.
Take a timed practice exam, check wrong answers in mongosh, practise weak areas and take a second exam.
days.deliverable: Two practice scores and a weak-areas list

days.topic: Intermediate Capstone: Scaled Order Platform on MongoDB
tools: MongoDB Atlas or a sharded cluster
days.lab_task: Build an order platform on a sharded cluster with a tested shard key, zones for EU data, encrypted personal fields, tuned queries, monitoring and alerts, then demo a failover and a resharding.
days.deliverable: Infrastructure code, model, dashboards and demo recording
objectives: Combine the intermediate topics in one platform

advanced.summary: For senior developers, DBAs and architects. Covers internals, very large sharded clusters, global clusters, multi-region disaster recovery, performance engineering, advanced schema design, multi-tenancy, security and compliance, encryption key management, AI applications with vector search, streaming with Atlas Stream Processing and Kafka, analytics, data lifecycle, migrations at scale, cost, platform operations, troubleshooting and strategy.
prerequisites: Runs replica sets or sharded clusters in production
Tunes queries and models data for scale
outcomes: Design global, sharded and multi-tenant MongoDB platforms
Tune performance and cost at very large scale
Build AI and streaming workloads on MongoDB
Lead migrations, operations and incident response

days.topic: MongoDB Internals: Query Engine, Replication and Storage
days.lab_task: Compare plans from the classic and slot-based engines, read the plan cache, trace a write through the oplog and analyse diagnostic data for a slowdown.

subtopics: Chunk counts and migrations at scale
days.lab_task: Add shards to a loaded cluster, drain a shard for removal, measure the effect of scatter-gather queries and tune mongos placement.
Build a global cluster with zones for India, the EU and the US, route customers to their region, check residency and measure local and cross-region latency.
days.deliverable: Cluster configuration, residency checks and latency report
checks: No regulated data outside its region

tools: MongoDB Atlas or self-managed replica sets
days.lab_task: Design a two-region replica set with correct priorities, run a regional failover drill, fail back and automate a weekly restore test.
days.deliverable: DR design, drill report and restore job

subtopics: Index strategy for many query shapes
days.lab_task: Benchmark a mixed workload, fix the top bottlenecks including a hot counter document and a slow pipeline, and add a performance regression test.
days.deliverable: Benchmark reports, fixes and regression test

subtopics: Anti-patterns: massive arrays, bloated documents and too many collections
days.lab_task: Review three production-like schemas for anti-patterns, design fixes and plan an online migration with backward-compatible application changes.
checks: Old and new code work during migration

subtopics: Tenancy models: shared collection, collection per tenant and database per tenant
days.lab_task: Build a SaaS app with shared collections keyed by tenant and with a database per tenant, move a large tenant to its own shard and compare effort.
days.deliverable: Two designs, migration log and comparison

subtopics: Compliance with PCI DSS and HIPAA
days.lab_task: Move users to OIDC authentication, audit access to sensitive collections, isolate the network and prepare compliance evidence.
days.deliverable: Security configuration, audit samples and evidence pack

days.lab_task: Design key management for a payments platform, set customer-managed keys, rotate keys without downtime and delete a customer's data by destroying their key.
days.deliverable: Key design, rotation log and deletion evidence
checks: Key admins separate from database admins

days.topic: AI Applications with Atlas Vector Search
subtopics: Hybrid search with text and vectors
days.lab_task: Build a support assistant that retrieves policy documents with hybrid search filtered by product, stores conversation memory and evaluate retrieval on 50 questions.
days.deliverable: Assistant code, indexes and evaluation results

days.topic: Streaming with Atlas Stream Processing and Kafka
days.lab_task: Stream orders from Kafka into MongoDB, compute per-minute revenue with Atlas Stream Processing and publish order changes back to Kafka.
Add analytics nodes for reports, query archived and live data together with data federation and connect a BI tool through Atlas SQL.
days.deliverable: Configuration, federated queries and BI report

days.topic: Data Lifecycle: Archiving, Tiering and Retention
days.lab_task: Archive orders older than two years, keep them queryable, apply retention by data type and measure storage savings.
days.deliverable: Archive rules, retention settings and savings report
checks: Moved to the archive and still queryable

days.lab_task: Migrate a self-managed cluster to Atlas with live migration, sync two clusters with mongosync, validate data and run a cutover rehearsal.
days.deliverable: Migration plan, validation report and rehearsal log

days.lab_task: Review cost for five clusters, right-size two, drop unused indexes, archive cold data and report monthly savings.
checks: Smaller tiers with the same performance

days.lab_task: Build self-service cluster provisioning with standard templates, write developer guidance and a schema review process and set service levels.
Build fleet dashboards for 15 clusters, define availability and latency SLOs, aggregate logs and run a monthly health review with actions.
checks: Alert fires with the cluster name

days.lab_task: Diagnose five injected incidents (a missing index after a release, replication lag, an election storm, cache pressure and a connection storm), fix each and write a post-incident review.
days.deliverable: Diagnosis notes, fixes and a post-incident review

days.topic: Database Strategy: When to Choose MongoDB
subtopics: Document databases compared with relational, key-value and graph
days.lab_task: Evaluate MongoDB against PostgreSQL with JSONB and DynamoDB for three workloads, record decisions and present them to a role-play architecture board.
checks: Each workload scored on agreed criteria

days.lab_task: Design and build a global platform for a marketplace: regional zones, encryption with customer keys, multi-tenant design, vector search, stream processing, archiving and cost controls, then run a DR drill and present to an architecture board.
days.deliverable: Architecture records, infrastructure code, drill report and board presentation
checks: Regulated data stays in its region
objectives: Combine the advanced topics in one platform
